name: Marco Calderoni
original_name: マルコ・カルデローニ
source:
"Didn't I always tell you? Just quickly remember the rules of this town already." 

The detective who supervises Roberto.
He is well-connected and trusted by the citizens.
He is worried about the church and the protagonist.
